```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Setup
library(pacman)
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(lubridate)
library(summarytools)
library(mice)
p_load("tidyverse", "knitr", "usethis", "gitcreds")

```


## Lab 18: Responses 

Get the data: SEQL table / variable:

+ Weekday sleep: P_SLQ / SLD012

+ Weekend sleep: P_SLQ / SLD013 

+ Gender: DEMO_J / RIAGENDR 

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Code to get the data
db <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), dbname = "epi560.sqlite")
dat <- dbGetQuery(db, "SELECT 
  s.SEQN, 
  s.SLD012 AS DaySleep,
  s.SLD013 AS EndSleep,
  d.RIAGENDR AS Gender
FROM P_SLQ s
LEFT JOIN P_DEMO d ON s.SEQN = d.SEQN"
)

dbDisconnect(db)

```


```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Code for first figure
dat$Gender <- factor(dat$Gender, labels = c("Male", "Female"))

fig1 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = DaySleep, y = EndSleep, color = Gender, shape = Gender)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 3, width = 0, height = 0.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Male" = "#a1a9b5", "Female" = "#e98176")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Male" = 16, "Female" = 17)) +
  labs(
    x = "Sleep hours: weekday",
    y = "Sleep hours: weekend",
    caption = "Panel A: Scatter plot of weekday vs weekend sleep hours"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

```


```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Reshape to long format
dat_long <- dat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(DaySleep, EndSleep),
               names_to = "SleepType",
               values_to = "Hours")

dat_long$SleepType <- recode(dat_long$SleepType,
                              DaySleep = "Weekday",
                              EndSleep = "Weekend")

# Code for second figure
fig2 <- ggplot(dat_long, aes(x = Gender, y = Hours, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = "#a1a9b5", "Female" = "#e98176")) +
  facet_wrap(~ SleepType, nrow = 1, strip.position = "top") +
  labs(
    x = "Gender",
    y = "Sleep Hours",
    caption = "Panel B: Violin plot of sleep hours stratified by gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

```


```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Code to combine plots
#install.packages("patchwork")
library(patchwork)
fig1 / fig2 + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Sleep patterns by gender",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22)
    )
  )

```
